name: io.github.adel-s/frigate-auth-mcp
title: Frigate Auth
description: MCP server with authentication for Frigate NVR (authenticated port, viewer role)

environmentVariables.name: FRIGATE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the authenticated Frigate port

environmentVariables.name: FRIGATE_USER
environmentVariables.description: Frigate username with the viewer role

environmentVariables.name: FRIGATE_IMAGE_CAMERAS
environmentVariables.description: Cameras allowed to return images, comma-separated; default all
